title: Battery Management PCBA
blurb: Altium board that monitors 8 cells, manages charging and talks CAN. It flew on a solar sailboat in the Pacific, Summer 2025.
description: As part of UBC Sailbot, I designed a board in Altium that interfaced the BQ7692006PWR to collect voltage and current data and to charge and discharge the batteries to optimize available power. It also relayed voltage data to the main system computer, and contributed to the successful launch of an autonomous solar-powered research sailboat that collects ocean and atmospheric data in Summer 2025.
bullets: Reads voltages of 8 cells forming a 12V battery pack
Current sensing for safe operation (over-current protection, state of charge)
I2C link to an STM32 development board
Low-side FET driver to manage charging and discharging
CAN transceiver sending voltage and current readings to the main vessel computer

title: Autonomous Robots
blurb: Two robots in 8 weeks to assemble burgers in a simulated Overcooked. I built the H-bridge, IR line sensor and debouncer boards.
description: In a team of 4, we designed 2 robots in 8 weeks to play a simulated game of Overcooked, working together to assemble burgers. I designed the electrical system, from PCBs to harnessing to microcontroller integration.
bullets: H-bridge PCB: speed and direction control of two motors with an LT1161 high-side driver and N-channel MOSFETs, for 12V and 5V motors, driven by PWM
IR line detection PCB: reflectance sensor with sensitivity tuned by a potentiometer, using an IR emitter and phototransistor
Push button debouncing: microswitch in, 3V3 or 0 out, using a comparator with hysteresis and a low-pass filter

title: Strain Gauge + Load Cell DAQ
alt: Strain gauge and load cell PCBA
blurb: Board that measures stress and force on concrete up to failure, informing a Mars atmosphere simulation chamber.
description: As part of UBC Mars Colony, I designed a board in Altium to measure the stress and force applied to concrete at failure. The data informed the design of a Mars atmosphere simulation chamber.
bullets: LDO voltage regulators
4 strain gauge inputs and 1 load cell input
5 operational amplifiers
Outputs to an ESP32 to collect data

title: Power Inductor Analysis Tool
blurb: Researching custom power inductors for matching networks in alternating magnetic fields.
description: Currently researching how to build custom power inductors for a matching network that reduces impedance in an alternating magnetic field setup, then streamlining the process into a reusable workflow for any alternating magnetic field system.

title: Gyroscopic Precession Stabilizer
blurb: A device that uses a flywheel’s stored angular momentum to create a correcting torque that prevents falls.
description: Currently designing and testing a device that uses gyroscopic precession to prevent people from falling, creating a correcting torque from the stored angular momentum of a flywheel. Inspired by satellite control moment gyroscopes. All mechanical and electrical systems are designed by a team of 2.

title: Modular DAQ PCBA
blurb: A modular base board with 4 edge card slots that made bringing up new sensors and actuators about 10x faster.
description: At Until Labs I built a modular data acquisition system that made bringup of new sensor and actuator configurations about 10x faster, including the base PCBA, custom edge PCBAs and the base firmware.
bullets: Base board built around the ATSAMD51N20A microcontroller
4 edge card slots for thermocouples, heaters, load cells, pump actuators and more
Data rates up to 12 MB/s
CAN passthrough to network multiple edge devices together
UART or CAN link to a host computer running the control system software

title: Thermocouple Interface
blurb: A 4-channel thermocouple edge card for the modular DAQ system, running over its own 3 MB/s SPI line.
description: I designed a 4x thermocouple edge card for the modular DAQ system. It connects to the base device through a unified connector standard and communicates over a dedicated SPI line at 3 MB/s.
bullets: 4 thermocouple channels on one card
Unified connector standard shared with the base board
Dedicated SPI line at 3 MB/s
Interfaces with various thermocouple types
